notes.title: Update: T-SPIN Quad!
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings everyone, here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][h1][b]T-Spin Quad arrives[/b][/h1][p]
Thanks to community player [i]Sunday[/i] for the idea!
\[Match-3] mode now includes [b]T-Spin Quad[/b], plus [b]Mini T-Spin Triple[/b] and [b]Mini T-Spin Quad[/b].[/p][list][*][p]Pulling these off will grant you a big score boost.[/p][/*][*][p]In versus mode, they’ll send a hefty amount of trash lines to your opponent.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]\[Match-3] Clear Condition Change[/b][/h1][p]Changed from “Matches 40” to “Reach 1000 Score”[/p][p][/p][h1][b]Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p]On the main menu, the \[Reward] button description now displays in full.[/p][/*][*][p]The Back button on the main menu can now be selected using a controller or keyboard arrow keys.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Poker mode statistics in Weekly Tasks will now be counted correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where unexpected combos could appear in rare field conditions.[/p][/*][/list][p]Enjoy the game! [/p]

notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes: [p]Hey everyone![/p][h1]The [b]DEMO is back![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45587649/d7b82ae429de78bf30be94335386d552dba7bd92.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]I’ve made some cool upgrades this time: [/h2][p][/p][h2]🔹Save Data Support[/h2][list][*][p]DEMO save files are now fully compatible with the full version.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔹 Achievements Enabled[/h3][list][*][p]You can now unlock achievements directly in the DEMO.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔹 Daily & Weekly Leaderboards[/h3][list][*][p]Compete on global leaderboards updated daily and weekly.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔹 New 40L Mode Affix: “SlimField”[/h3][list][*][p]Added a 5-column width modifier for 40L mode. Show your precision in tight spaces![/p][/*][/list][h3]🔹 New Reward Items[/h3][list][*][p]Added dark background and warning lights as unlockable items.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🔹 Piece Color Customization[/h3][list][*][p]Added new color schemes in Settings:[/p][list][*][p]Eye Care Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Colorblind-Friendly Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Grayscale Mode[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Hope you enjoy [b]“Quadra Break DEMO”![/b][/h2][p]As always, feedback is welcome![/p][p][/p]
